properties.note: A new member of the genre this ruling was written over: an agent-authored field report from the 2026-08-31 musicjug genesis session, frozen as of that date. It implements nothing, specifies nothing and describes nothing — it records what one session saw — so none of REALIZES / DOCUMENTS / SPECIFIES / PRODUCES / SATISFIES is true of it, and DOCUMENTS in particular would invert the direction of obligation by making every future design change read as staling a report that is simply history.
